title: PRE RAID WHOLE NAMES AND CHOSEN MAP TYPE
why: v35.81 clipped pack names and replaced the chosen map sizes. The ledger still has its SP value under the new counted kills label.
now: Pack names wrap beside the same controls. The pack keeps scroll space at 4K. Zones return to the chosen 20 px start and 14 px floor; exits and keyed rooms return to 18 px. The 24 px long dock label crowded a room outline at both resolutions. Comparison pictures: tools/handoff/console/notes/shots/o-09d-red-35.81-preraid-names-and-ledger-recipes-2/preraid-zones-20-1080.jpg, preraid-zones-24-1080.jpg, preraid-zones-20-4k.jpg and preraid-zones-24-4k.jpg. Terms and rewards keep their readability gains. Watch: scroll a long pack at 4K; full names, prices and steppers must stay readable and ascend must remain reachable.
